description: This Java class 'BomBuilder' generates BOM (Bill of Materials) CSV files from component and PCB data, including full and compact lists, with options for filtering and comments.

classes.name: BomBuilder
classes.description: Main class responsible for building BOM CSV files from component and PCB data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments, reads files, and generates BOM lists.

methods.name: writeMissingElements
methods.description: Writes entries for components missing BOM records.

methods.name: writeFullPartList
methods.description: Generates a full BOM CSV listing all components.

methods.name: findModule
methods.description: Checks if a component reference exists in the PCB modules.

methods.name: writeCompactPartList
methods.description: Generates a compact BOM CSV listing unique component types.

methods.name: writeCommonHeader
methods.description: Writes header comments to BOM CSV files.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a line for a BOM entry in CSV format.

methods.name: readBomDictionary
methods.description: Parses BOM dictionary CSV lines into a map of BomRecord objects.
